description.zh: 规则ID，选填，不传入则会新增加白规则。
description.en: The rule ID. This parameter is optional. If you do not specify this parameter, a whitelist rule is created.

description.zh:
告警名称：
- ALL： 全部告警类型
description.en:
The alerting name. Valid values:
- ALL: all Alarm Metric.
The value of the field to be whitelisted.

description.zh:
规则判定操作符：
- strEqual：字符串相等
description.en:
The operator used for rule matching. Valid values:
- strEqual: string equals.

description.zh:
业务来源：
- agentless：无代理检测
description.en:
The business source. Valid values:
- agentless: agentless detection.

description.zh:
生效目标类型：
- ALL：全部资产
- SELECTION_KEY：通过资产选择组件选中的资产
description.en:
The type of the target scope. Valid values:
- ALL: all assets
- SELECTION_KEY: assets selected by using the asset selection component.

description.zh:
目标生效范围：
- ALL：全部资产
- 其他：资产选择组件选中的资产范围Key
description.en:
The target scope. Valid values:
- ALL: all assets
- Other values: the key of the asset scope selected by using the asset selection component.

title.zh: 修改无代理检测敏感文件告警加白规则
title.en: Modify a whitelist rule for agentless sensitive file detection alerts

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas update-malicious-file-whitelist-config --config-id 1 --event-name ALL --field fileMd5 --operator strEqual --field-value b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --target-type ALL --target-value ALL --source agentless --remark test --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas UpdateMaliciousFileWhitelistConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Operator strEqual --Field fileMd5 --TargetValue ALL --TargetType ALL --ConfigId 1 --EventName ALL --FieldValue b2cf9747ee49d8d9b105cf16e078cc16 --Source agentless --Remark test
